Definition: to be a man, i.e. act in a manly way
BiblicalUsage: To act like a man is the call God gives to the rebels in Isaiah. In Isaiah 46:8 he says, remember this, and shew yourselves men, bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the call is still God's word to me: remember, show yourself a man, and bring to mind what you have forgotten.
